# Deployment Topologies and Reliability {#sec-deployment}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- choose between managed runtimes and self-hosted containers with a stated rationale;
- make side-effecting agent actions safe to retry;
- bound an agent by steps, tokens, and wall-clock time;
- undo what an agent did when it goes wrong.

## Exercises

1. Take an agent with side-effecting tools. Add idempotency keys and prove double-execution is impossible.
2. Write the compensating action for each side-effecting tool in your system. Which one has no compensation?
